codes.reason: Pulkovo 1995 / Gauss-Kruger 15N duplicated Pulkovo 1995 / Gauss-Kruger CM 87E (identical definition, 500 km false easting with no zone prefix, so the 'zone N' name was misleading); replaced by the CM-named CRS.
Not deprecated: GSK-2011 / Gauss-Kruger zone 31 is a live record.

Beijing 1954 / Gauss-Kruger 21N duplicated Beijing 1954 / Gauss-Kruger CM 123E (identical definition, false easting without zone prefix, so the zone-number name was misleading); replaced by the CM-named CRS.
WGS 84 / Mercator 41 was defined with the wrong method: Mercator (variant A) with latitude of natural origin -41; corrected as Mercator (variant B) with standard parallel at 41 S in EPSG:3994.
Not deprecated: GDA2020 geographic 3D CRS is live.

World Equidistant Cylindrical (Sphere) used the spherical method on the GRS 1980 authalic sphere with an unspecified datum; replaced by WGS 84 / World Equidistant Cylindrical, which uses the ellipsoidal method on WGS 84.
